decisions.reason: Operator training builds on established service capabilities, costs little to maintain, and supports machine sales, so the option is cheap to hold.
A fourth rotary axis is a low-cost modular accessory for the core machine line, so keeping it costs little and preserves upside.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core business, was only mentioned and never given its own page, and needs costly specialized commitment, so its value looks unlikely to be realized relative to the firm's many other options.
The high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the firm's core and has its own page, making it central to the business rather than a speculative option.
The automatic tool change system complements the core machines, is presented prominently, and costs little to keep alongside existing systems.
